posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of 4 distinct spots forming a geometric line across the mid-thigh region.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white patch on the lower throat/neck region and high-contrast white spotting on the lateral muzzle area.
